denominators: Only valid scored items enter correctness; show planned coverage, execution success and each excluded state separately.

rules.normalization: Trim only leading/trailing Unicode whitespace. Case-sensitive literal membership in per-case aliases. No Unicode/case folding.
Trim Unicode whitespace; optional ASCII minus followed by ASCII decimal digits; i64 numeric comparison. No plus, decimals, expressions or implicit units.

Docker Linux only, pinned Python 3.13 image digest before execution. Exact Python return types before serialization; deep input mutation check; per-assertion result. No network/socket/sensitive mounts or host fallback. Freeze CPU/RAM/PID/time/output limits; clean owned container and files. Sandbox unavailable is Execution Error, never Failed.
rules.result: passed/total assertions and all_passed; unavailable sandbox is blocked, never zero

rules.normalization: Strict structured status/facts/reason/citations. Compare typed facts with explicit aliases; adjudicate status/refusal/conflict/as_of separately. Citation is supporting only when its claim_id and full span are in the annotated evidence map; reject duplicate/unknown citations. Answer and citation correctness separate; all dimensions required for full pass. Zero citations precision=N/A; missing required evidence cannot pass.
rules.result: answer correctness and citation correctness separately

rules.normalization: Strict single JSON, reject duplicate keys/nonfinite values. JSON Schema 2020-12 with date format assertion; semantic comparison of typed values. Object order irrelevant, arrays ordered, integer mathematical equivalence, bool distinct from numbers, null distinct from missing. Unknown scorer vocabulary is Scoring Error.

Exactly one actual structured Provider tool_call, never text JSON. Validate name/required arguments/types/no extras and semantic values with integer equivalence. No side effects or tool dispatch. Unsupported only with capability evidence; missing capture is system Execution Error, not model failure.
